exercises.title: Reviews 1 — Order the five activities of the review process
exercises.problemHtml:
ISTQB CTFL 2018 describes the work-product review process as five activities, from planning the review to reporting its results. Put them in the order in which they happen (SWT3 slide 24).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
ISTQB CTFL 2018 mô tả quy trình review sản phẩm gồm năm hoạt động, từ lập kế hoạch review tới báo cáo kết quả. Sắp chúng theo đúng thứ tự diễn ra (SWT3 slide 24).

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Reviews 2 — In which activity does each task happen? — answer key

1. Activity of each taskHoạt động của từng việc
   - r0.a: Planning
   - r1.a: Planning
   - r2.a: Planning
   - r3.a: Initiate review
   - r4.a: Initiate review
   - r5.a: Individual review
   - r6.a: Issue communication and analysis
   - r7.a: Issue communication and analysis
   - r8.a: Issue communication and analysis
   - r9.a: Fixing and reporting
   - r10.a: Fixing and reporting
   - r11.a: Fixing and reporting
   Planning: scope, effort, roles, entry check. Initiate: distribute and explain. Individual review: read and note. Issue communication and analysis: communicate, analyse, own, evaluate vs exit criteria. Fixing and reporting: defect reports, fixing, metrics, acceptance.VI: Lập kế hoạch: phạm vi, công sức, vai trò, kiểm tiêu chí vào. Khởi động: phát và giải thích. Review cá nhân: đọc và ghi chú. Trao đổi & phân tích: báo, phân tích, giao chủ, so tiêu chí ra. Sửa & báo cáo: báo cáo lỗi, sửa, số liệu, chấp nhận.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Planning ×3 · Initiate ×2 · Individual ×1 · Issue communication and analysis ×3 · Fixing and reporting ×3.

bang.de:
Activity of each task

Hoạt động của từng việc

o.t: Defining the scope, purpose and the work products to review
Estimating effort and timeframe; selecting people and allocating roles
Checking entry criteria (for more formal review types)
Distributing the work product and other material
Explaining the scope, objectives, process and roles to the participants
Reviewing all or part of the work product; noting potential defects, recommendations and questions
Communicating identified potential defects (e.g. in a review meeting)
Analysing potential defects, assigning ownership and status to them
Evaluating the review findings against the exit criteria to make a review decision
Creating defect reports for findings that require changes
Fixing defects in the work product (typically by the author)
Gathering metrics and accepting the work product when the exit criteria are reached

bang.giaiThich:
Planning: scope, effort, roles, entry check. Initiate: distribute and explain. Individual review: read and note. Issue communication and analysis: communicate, analyse, own, evaluate vs exit criteria. Fixing and reporting: defect reports, fixing, metrics, acceptance.

VI: Lập kế hoạch: phạm vi, công sức, vai trò, kiểm tiêu chí vào. Khởi động: phát và giải thích. Review cá nhân: đọc và ghi chú. Trao đổi & phân tích: báo, phân tích, giao chủ, so tiêu chí ra. Sửa & báo cáo: báo cáo lỗi, sửa, số liệu, chấp nhận.

1. Role of each responsibilityVai trò của từng trách nhiệm
   - r0.r: Author
   - r1.r: Management
   - r2.r: Management
   - r3.r: Facilitator (moderator)
   - r4.r: Review leader
   - r5.r: Reviewer
   - r6.r: Scribe (recorder)
   - r7.r: Scribe (recorder)

Vai trò của từng trách nhiệm

o.t: Creates the work product under review and fixes its defects
Decides on the execution of reviews; allocates staff, budget and time

Ensures review meetings run effectively; mediates between viewpoints

Records new defects, open points and decisions during the review meeting

# Reviews 4 — Process and roles, exam style — answer key

1. In which activity are the review findings evaluated against the exit criteria to make a review decision?Ở hoạt động nào các phát hiện review được so với tiêu chí ra để quyết định?
   Answer: c) Issue communication and analysis
   Evaluating findings vs exit criteria is part of issue communication and analysis; checking that exit criteria are MET and accepting the product happen in fixing and reporting.VI: So phát hiện với tiêu chí ra thuộc trao đổi & phân tích; kiểm tiêu chí ra đã ĐẠT và chấp nhận sản phẩm nằm ở sửa & báo cáo.

2. Which role is usually responsible for fixing the defects found in the work product?Vai trò nào thường sửa các lỗi tìm thấy trong sản phẩm?
   Answer: b) Author
   The author owns the work product and does the rework.VI: Tác giả sở hữu sản phẩm và làm lại phần sửa.

3. In an inspection, who must NOT act as the facilitator (moderator)?Trong inspection, ai KHÔNG được làm facilitator?
   Answer: b) The author
   Inspections are led by a trained facilitator who is not the author, so the process stays objective.VI: Inspection do facilitator được đào tạo dẫn và không phải tác giả, để quy trình khách quan.

4. What is done during the initiate-review activity?Hoạt động initiate review làm gì?
   Answer: b) Distributing the work product and explaining the scope, objectives, process, roles and work products; answering questions
   Initiate review = the kick-off: material out, purpose explained, questions answered.VI: Initiate review = buổi kick-off: phát tài liệu, giải thích mục đích, trả lời câu hỏi.

5. According to the slides, the success of a review often depends most on…Theo slide, thành công của buổi review thường phụ thuộc nhiều nhất vào…
   Answer: b) the facilitator (moderator)
   The syllabus: “the success of the review often depends on the facilitator”.VI: Syllabus: “thành công của review thường phụ thuộc vào facilitator”.

exercises.title: Reviews 5 — Review the LabBook requirements and log the issues
exercises.problemHtml:
You are a reviewer in the individual-review activity of a LabBook requirements review. Read the 12 requirements and log every potential defect: the requirement number, its type, a description and a suggested fix. Two requirements are fine — logging them is a false positive.

 1  R1   The system shall let a student book a seat in a lab.
 2  R2   A booking lasts between 1 and 3 hours.
 3  R3   Bookings must be made at least 1 hour and at most 2 weeks in advance.
 4  R4   The system shall respond quickly.
 5  R5   When a lab is full, the student is added to the waitlist.
 6  R6   When a confirmed booking is cancelled, the waitlist is promoted.
 7  R7   A student may book at most 6 hours per calendar week.
 8  R8   Students can cancel their bookings.
 9  R9   Bookings are confirmed by e-mail.
10  R10  A lab can be closed by the administrator.
11  R11  Closed labs cannot be booked, except by staff.
12  R12  The booking date must be after today.

Types: AMBIGUOUS · INCOMPLETE · INCONSISTENT · UNTESTABLE · INCORRECT · REDUNDANT.

Requirements

  • ISSUES = [{ line: 4, type: "UNTESTABLE", description, fix }] — line = requirement number; for a conflict between two requirements give both, e.g. "3,12".
  • Find at least 6 real issues, including the three critical ones; every issue with a concrete fix.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Bạn là reviewer trong bước review cá nhân của buổi review yêu cầu LabBook. Đọc 12 yêu cầu và ghi mọi lỗi tiềm năng: số hiệu yêu cầu, loại, mô tả và gợi ý sửa. Có hai yêu cầu không có lỗi — ghi chúng là báo nhầm.

 1  R1   The system shall let a student book a seat in a lab.
 2  R2   A booking lasts between 1 and 3 hours.
 3  R3   Bookings must be made at least 1 hour and at most 2 weeks in advance.
 4  R4   The system shall respond quickly.
 5  R5   When a lab is full, the student is added to the waitlist.
 6  R6   When a confirmed booking is cancelled, the waitlist is promoted.
 7  R7   A student may book at most 6 hours per calendar week.
 8  R8   Students can cancel their bookings.
 9  R9   Bookings are confirmed by e-mail.
10  R10  A lab can be closed by the administrator.
11  R11  Closed labs cannot be booked, except by staff.
12  R12  The booking date must be after today.

Loại: AMBIGUOUS · INCOMPLETE · INCONSISTENT · UNTESTABLE · INCORRECT · REDUNDANT.

Yêu cầu

  • ISSUES = [{ line: 4, type: "UNTESTABLE", description, fix }] — line = số hiệu yêu cầu; mâu thuẫn giữa hai yêu cầu thì ghi cả hai, vd "3,12".
  • Tìm ít nhất 6 lỗi thật, gồm ba lỗi nghiêm trọng; mỗi lỗi có cách sửa cụ thể.

examplesJson.input: { line: 4, type: "UNTESTABLE", description: "“quickly” is not measurable" }
examplesJson.output: counts as the critical issue on R4
examplesJson.explanation: Fix: “95% of booking requests answer within 2 seconds with 200 concurrent users”.|||Sửa: “95% yêu cầu đặt chỗ trả lời trong 2 giây với 200 người dùng đồng thời”.

hintsJson: Đọc từng câu với câu hỏi: đo được không? đủ chưa (ai, khi nào, bao nhiêu)? có câu nào khác nói ngược lại không?
R3 cho phép đặt trong ngày (trước 1 giờ) nhưng R12 cấm ngày hôm nay — mâu thuẫn.

solutionCodeJson.name: answer.js
solutionCodeJson.code:
// Review log — 8 issues; R1 and R7 are fine.
const ISSUES = [
  { line: 4, type: 'UNTESTABLE', description: '“Respond quickly” has no measurable criterion.', fix: '95% of booking requests answered within 2 s with 200 concurrent users.' },
  { line: 6, type: 'INCOMPLETE', description: 'How is the waitlist promoted — first come first served? Several people at once? Are they notified?', fix: 'Promote waiting bookings of that lab and day first come first served while seats are free; e-mail each promoted student.' },
  { line: '3,12', type: 'INCONSISTENT', description: 'R3 allows a booking today (1 hour ahead) but R12 forbids today.', fix: 'Delete R12 or change it to “the booking start must be at least 1 hour after now”.' },
  { line: 2, type: 'AMBIGUOUS', description: 'Can a booking last 1.5 hours? Whole hours only? Must it end before closing time?', fix: 'A booking lasts 1, 2 or 3 whole hours and must end by 21:00.' },
  { line: 5, type: 'INCOMPLETE', description: '“Full” is not defined (seats per lab? per hour?) and the waitlist has no limit or status.', fix: 'A lab is full for an hour when the CONFIRMED bookings covering it equal its seats; the new booking gets status PENDING.' },
  { line: '10,11', type: 'INCONSISTENT', description: 'R10 says the administrator closes labs, R11 mentions “staff” — who are they, and may they book closed labs?', fix: 'Define the roles (Manager closes labs) and remove the exception or define it precisely.' },
  { line: 9, type: 'INCOMPLETE', description: 'Which events send an e-mail (confirmed, waitlisted, promoted, cancelled)?', fix: 'List the e-mail events and their subjects.' },
  { line: 8, type: 'INCOMPLETE', description: 'No cancellation deadline: can a booking be cancelled after it started?', fix: 'A booking can be cancelled until 2 hours before its start.' },
];

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: R4 untestable (“quickly”); R6 incomplete (order of promotion? FIFO?); R3/R12 inconsistent (same-day booking); R2 ambiguous (whole hours?); R5 incomplete (when is a lab “full”: seats per hour?); R10/R11 inconsistent/ambiguous (administrator vs “staff”, undefined); R9 incomplete (which events send e-mails?); R8 incomplete (cancellation deadline?).
